responsibility: Index document for the `dmd/common` support library shared by the D front end and back end. It summarizes the purpose of common utility files such as bitfield packing, file I/O, output buffering, and string/path helpers, serving as navigation documentation rather than compiler logic.
same_name_distinction: This README is specific to the `common/` support library shared by front end and back end. Unlike the top-level `gcc/d/dmd/README.md`, it is not a whole-tree map, and unlike `root/README.md`, it indexes the smaller shared `common` utilities such as bitfields, file I/O, outbuffer, and filename/string helpers.
